entities.name: Karona
entities.description: The manifestation of all Dominarian mana, brought into being and defeated twice.

entities.name: Numena
entities.description: Three wizard-kings who conquered Otaria's lands, whose powers accidentally birthed Karona and who destroyed her.

entities.name: Akroma
entities.description: One of three women whose deaths reborn Karona.

entities.name: Phage
entities.description: One of three women whose deaths recreated Karona; survives as Jeska with a planeswalker spark.

entities.name: Zagorka
entities.description: One of three women whose deaths recreated Karona.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: Pit fighter who wields the Mirari Sword and Soul Reaper, who stands against Karona.

entities.name: Ixidor
entities.description: Mortal avatar of the Numena Lowallyn.

entities.name: Kuberr
entities.description: Numena who built fortunes at the Grand Coliseum.

entities.name: Lowallyn
entities.description: A Numena; also summoned through Karona's blue portal.

entities.name: Arien
entities.description: A being concocted by the Numena as a trap to bind Karona.

entities.name: Sash
entities.description: An unman, Karona's disciple, who pierced her with the Mirari Sword on Lord Macht's advice.

entities.name: Waistcoat
entities.description: An unman, Karona's disciple, who pierced her with the Mirari Sword on Lord Macht's advice.

entities.name: Lord Macht
entities.description: Creator of the plane Argentum who guided the unmen and took Karona to Argentum.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Phyrexian figure who met Karona and spoke to her through the portals.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Came through Karona's white portal.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: A being who told Karona that Dominaria was her true home.

entities.name: Gaea
entities.description: The only god on Dominaria, hurt by Karona's presence.

entities.name: Mirari Sword
entities.description: Sword with which Kamahl stood against Karona and with which Sash and Waistcoat pierced her.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: The war-torn continent devastated by Karona.

entities.name: Grand Coliseum
entities.description: Site destroyed as Karona's worshippers tore its foundations apart.

entities.name: Averru
entities.description: City above which Karona arrived and was trapped by the Numena.

entities.name: Sanctum
entities.description: The only city opposing Karona's rule.

entities.name: Argentum
entities.description: Lord Macht's artificial plane.

entities.name: Karona's War
entities.description: The war in which Karona gathered worshippers into an army to take over Otaria.

entities.name: Fall of the Numena
entities.description: The destruction of the Numena's power and lives after they destroyed Karona.

events.summary: The Numena's conflict accidentally births Karona, and the Numena unite to destroy her after thirteen months at the cost of their power and lives.
events.quote: Karona existed for only thirteen months before the Numena managed to destroy her

events.summary: Akroma, Phage and Zagorka are slain by Kamahl's Soul Reaper at the apex of their battle, and Karona is reborn from their fused bodies.
events.quote: wrought from the fused bodies of the three great women

events.summary: Karona decides she must be a goddess, believing the praise she receives.
events.quote: Karona soon assumed that she must be a goddess

events.summary: Karona summons five portals seeking her equal; Teferi, Lowallyn, Yawgmoth, Fiers and Multani come through, and Yawgmoth's words lead her to decide to destroy the gods.
events.quote: Karona summoned five portals to search for her equal

events.summary: Karona's presence destroys the Grand Coliseum as her worshippers tear its foundation apart.
events.quote: her very presence led to the destruction of the Grand Coliseum

events.summary: Above Averru, Karona is drawn by Arien and trapped by the three Numena; Kamahl stops their assault and has her banished.
events.quote: Kamahl chose to see her banished from their world instead

events.summary: In the Blind Eternities Karona follows a path to a plane of yellow skies where locals reject her, and flees.
events.quote: Terrified, Karona fled by moving to another plane.

events.summary: Karona and her disciples meet Serra, who tells her Dominaria is her true home.
events.quote: Serra's only advice was to remind Karona that she was Dominaria's magic

events.summary: At the remnants of Phyrexia Yawgmoth urges her to stay, but warned by Sash and Waistcoat, Karona leaves.
On a metal plane Karona recognizes Lord Macht, forgives his guilt over the Mirari and is transported back to Dominaria.
events.quote: the grateful Lord Macht transported Karona back to Dominaria

events.summary: Karona gathers an army and wages Karona's War across Otaria, destroying cities.
events.quote: Karona attempted to take over all of Otaria by gathering those who praised her into an army

events.summary: Karona kills the three Numena one by one and decrees Kamahl's death.
events.quote: She killed all three Numena one by one

events.summary: Sash and Waistcoat pierce Karona with the Mirari Sword on Lord Macht's advice; Macht takes her to Argentum where she dies, regressing into the three women, with Jeska surviving.
events.quote: the two un-men, pierced Karona's belly with the Mirari Sword

relations.note: Their powers accidentally gave birth to her.
relations.quote: their powers accidentally gave birth to the being they called Mother
before the Numena managed to destroy her

relations.note: Killed all three in her war.
relations.quote: She killed all three Numena one by one

relations.note: With Waistcoat, pierced her with the Mirari Sword.
relations.quote: pierced Karona's belly with the Mirari Sword
Both unmen were acting under advice from Lord Macht

relations.note: Instructed by Lord Macht to stop her.
relations.quote: Kamahl, who had been instructed to stop Karona by the mysterious Lord Macht

relations.note: Ixidor is the mortal avatar of Lowallyn.
relations.quote: Ixidor, the mortal avatar of the Numena Lowallyn

relations.note: Karona decided to destroy the gods.
relations.quote: she would destroy them and assume power
